name: HY-Motion: B_Shot_Fall. From a natural standing stance, immediately push both knees sharply forward while violently hyperextending the spine backward, forcing the entire torso to drop into an extreme backbend parallel to the ground (Matrix-style bullet dodge). The hips must thrust forward to maintain balance. As the back approaches the ground, the left hand slams flat onto the floor to support the weight, stopping any frantic arm flailing. Simultaneously, the right arm locks rigidly and extends diagonally upward at a 35-degree angle from the ground, firing the pistol straight up at the forward target.
